sourceReferences.supports: Some Russian nouns have a zero ending in the genitive plural; choice varies with declension pattern and stem. Genitive plural uses zero, -ов/-ев, or -ей; neuter nouns exhibit more than one pattern. The sources attest карты → карт, болота → болот, яблоки → яблок, and пять книг.
